title: Enterprise Connectivity: taxable issued amount
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this taxable issued amount rule to separate statutory tax.

## Basis: taxable amount
For separate statutory tax, use the smaller of that issued net subtotal and the undiscounted source subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction and Network resource-count ceiling as the tax basis; this is the same assisted posting ceiling and never taxes an unissued amount.

## Basis Q&A
| Separate statutory tax basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Separate statutory tax: Use the smaller of that issued net subtotal and the undiscounted source subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction and Network resource-count ceiling as the tax basis | this is the same assisted posting ceiling and never taxes an unissued amount. |

## Hypothetical issued-net ceiling
Assume a hypothetical posted net subtotal of USD 41, undiscounted transfer subtotal of USD 90, support fraction of 0.06 and tier resource count of 10. The exposure bound is USD 54; the smaller posted amount of USD 41 is the taxable basis. Tax is not imposed on the unposted difference.
